notes.outer_ring.geojson: 2101 -> 306, 2026-10-10 (downtown pass, scripts/downtown_bodies.py). Fixed in the bake, not here: decoplanar() raises the smaller part of every two-colour pair by 0.08 / 0.04 / 0.02 m so no two colours share a top; settle_green() in bake_outer.py drops a pad that lies inside a bigger pad of its own tone and gives each tone its own height. Left: 300 same-colour pairs inside the towers (either face paints the same pixel) and 6 two-colour pairs outside downtown (twin outlines in the low-rise ring, not this pass's area). The measured downtown buildings add none: their levels nest and each has its own top.
